purpose: Measures whether the description field triggers the skill. This is a different measurement from evals.json, which tests behaviour once the skill is already loaded. Keeping them in one file would mean a failure could not be traced to a layer.
note: The negatives are deliberately near-misses. They share vocabulary or intent with sapiens but need something else, usually the avoid-ai-writing skill or no skill at all.
